svg.title: Chatbot Integration Architecture
svg.desc: Corp Website, AIA+ App and Facebook Messenger connect to Chatbot. The latter two touchpoints are grouped in Phase II. The ten Chatbot modules are shown above the digital self-service and live-agent destinations. Agent Integration invokes Chat Agent in GenAI Hub 2.0 and receives its AG-UI event stream. The hub retrieves knowledge from KMS / KB.
